title: Odyssey Ai-Dual Jailbird Mini Double Bend 34" Golf Putter $257.56 Delivered @ Amazon JP via AU
body:
Deal: Odyssey Ai-Dual Jailbird Mini Double Bend 34" Golf Putter $257.56 Delivered @ Amazon JP via AU

[Lizard Spock] I suggest feather touch…. You have entered: Power Drive!
[HD9990] good deal, just wondering what's so AI about it?
[wombat81] The face insert is AI designed apparently.
[HD9990] it looks &feels exactly the same as old putter with the white insert….
[wombat81] The AI-One? Not really surprising since it's face insert was also AI designed.
[wombat81] @HD9990: Ok. Keep using your old putter, then?
[HD9990] @wombat81: sadly already sold the old one. the point is don't fall for the AI GIMMICK, at least for putter. but for this price it's a decent putter anyways
[OzzyB123] Shame it's so short, have tried putting with a 34 and it just feels tiny! Wish the 35" was available
[wombat81] You pretty much can't get putters longer than 34" in Japan, sadly. I looked everywhere while I was there last year.
But I'm 6'1 and switch between 34 and 35 inch putters. Really depends on your wrist to floor measurement.
[OzzyB123] Yeah, tempted to pull the trigger at this price and go to my local pro shop and have them extend the shaft
[wombat81] I mean you could probably resell it locally for more than you paid for it if you really didn't like it.
[Domingo] have them extend the shaft
That's what she said
[wombat81] @Domingo: Wait till you hear the shaft model name…
